eps.ov: When the global network is disrupted, Haruka must use a power inherited from her father to protect her family.
Just after Akira's hidden power reveals itself, two unfamiliar women appear before him.
Haruka and Akira depart for Hokkaido with Eleanor and Lala to find the fifth Vertex.
On a deserted island, Lala devises a plan to use Akira as bait to lure EDVA to them.
As Lala works through the night alone to analyze the Battlenoid, the other four decide to make coffee for her.
The five Vertex visit a populated island to buy food, but its residents have evacuated due to a typhoon.
Lala comes up with a way to defeat EDVA, but putting the plan into action isn't so easy.
With EDVA out of the picture, the VERTEX are free to part ways... but Yoko has other ideas.
